pages.about: Nimbus Ledger makes invoicing and bookkeeping software for small businesses across Europe. The company has about 120 employees and has been remote-first since it was founded in 2019. Teams work asynchronously and write decisions down in public documents.
pages.product: The Nimbus app lets freelancers and small shops send invoices, track expenses and prepare VAT reports. More than 40,000 businesses use it every month.
pages.news: In March 2026 Nimbus Ledger launched multi-currency invoicing, so customers can bill clients in 18 currencies. The finance analytics team is growing to measure how customers adopt the feature.
pages.careers: We value clear writing, curiosity and ownership. Analysts at Nimbus work closely with product managers and present findings in a weekly metrics review.

pages.about: Fernwood Health runs a telehealth scheduling platform for clinics in the United States.
pages.product: Clinics use Fernwood to book video appointments, send reminders and reduce missed visits.
pages.news: Fernwood Health expanded to 300 clinics in 2026.
pages.careers: Because we handle US patient data, all roles require authorization to work in the United States.

pages.about: Orbital Grocers delivers groceries within 30 minutes in Berlin, Hamburg and Munich.
pages.product: Customers order through the Orbital app from a catalogue of 4,000 products stocked in small city warehouses.
pages.news: Orbital Grocers opened its tenth Berlin warehouse in 2026.
pages.careers: Most office roles are hybrid, with three days a week in our Berlin headquarters.

pages.about: Quill & Co Analytics is a 25-person data consultancy that builds dashboards and reporting for retailers and non-profit organisations. The whole team works remotely across nine countries.
pages.product: Quill delivers reporting projects in four to eight weeks, usually in Tableau or Power BI, and trains client staff to maintain them.
pages.news: In 2026 Quill started a programme offering discounted dashboards to small charities.
pages.careers: Junior analysts pair with a senior consultant on every client project and present their work directly to clients.

pages.about: Tidewater Mobility operates shared e-bikes and e-scooters in twelve cities across the Western Balkans, with its main office in Belgrade.
pages.product: Riders unlock vehicles in the Tidewater app. City partners receive monthly reports on trips, parking and safety.
pages.news: Tidewater Mobility launched in Novi Sad and Skopje in 2026 and now records about 1.5 million trips a month.
pages.careers: Our data team uses SQL and Python to plan where vehicles should be placed and to report to city governments.

pages.about: Brightloom Education runs an online learning platform with short professional courses in data, design and management.
pages.product: Learners take self-paced courses with weekly mentor sessions. Course teams use experiments to improve completion rates.
pages.news: Brightloom passed 500,000 enrolled learners in 2026 and opened a mentoring programme in Africa and the Middle East.
pages.careers: We hire remotely across Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA).

pages.about: Kestrel Logistics builds software that helps freight companies plan routes and track shipments.
pages.product: Dispatchers use Kestrel to assign loads and predict delivery times.
pages.news: Kestrel signed three national rail freight operators in 2026.
pages.careers: For legal reasons, we can only hire people who live in an EU member state.

pages.about: Pinecrest Games is an independent mobile games studio with 60 people working remotely around the world.
pages.product: Pinecrest's best-known game, Harbor Lights, is a cosy puzzle game with about two million monthly players.
pages.news: In 2026 Pinecrest began testing new levels with A/B experiments before releasing them to all players.
pages.careers: Our player insights team turns gameplay data into decisions for designers. We welcome applicants from any country.
